# Combobox { #anylumino.Combobox }

```python
Combobox(
    value='',
    options=(),
    description='',
    placeholder='',
    ensure_option=False,
    disabled=False,
    continuous_update=True,
    layout=None,
    style=None,
)
```

Text input with dropdown suggestions.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                           | Default    |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `''` |
| options | optional | Selectable values or ``(label, value)`` pairs. | `()` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| placeholder | optional | Text shown while the input is empty. | `''` |
| ensure_option | optional | Whether combobox values must be present in ``options``. | `False` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user is typing or dragging. | `True` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [ensure_option](#anylumino.Combobox.ensure_option) | If set, ensure value is in options. Implies continuous_update=False. |
| [options](#anylumino.Combobox.options) | Dropdown options for the combobox |
